```yaml
name: Contributor Actions

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  statuses: write

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      has_ts_changes: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.has_ts_changes }}
      has_docs_changes: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.has_docs_changes }}
      has_config_changes: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.has_config_changes }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Filter changes
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            has_ts_changes:
              - '**/*.ts'
              - '**/*.tsx'
              - '**/*.js'
              - '**/*.jsx'
              - 'package.json'
              - 'package-lock.json'
              - 'yarn.lock'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
            has_docs_changes:
              - '**/*.md'
              - 'docs/**'
            has_config_changes:
              - '.github/**'
              - 'tsconfig.json'
              - 'eslint.config.*'
              - 'prettier.config.*'

  lint-and-typecheck:
    name: Lint & Type Check
    needs: detect-changes
    if: ${{ needs.detect-changes.outputs.has_ts_changes == 'true' || needs.detect-changes.outputs.has_config_changes == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run ESLint
        run: npm run lint --if-present

      - name: Run Type Check
        run: npm run typecheck --if-present || npx tsc --noEmit

  build:
    name: Build
    needs: detect-changes
    if: ${{ needs.detect-changes.outputs.has_ts_changes == 'true' || needs.detect-changes.outputs.has_config_changes == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build --if-present

  test:
    name: Test
    needs: detect-changes
    if: ${{ needs.detect-changes.outputs.has_ts_changes == 'true' || needs.detect-changes.outputs.has_config_changes == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Tests
        run: npm test --if-present

  report-status:
    name: Report Status
    needs: [detect-changes, lint-and-typecheck, build, test]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check job statuses
        id: status-check
        run: |
          LINT_STATUS="${{ needs.lint-and-typecheck.result }}"
          BUILD_STATUS="${{ needs.build.result }}"
          TEST_STATUS="${{ needs.test.result }}"
          
          if [[ "$LINT_STATUS" == "success" || "$LINT_STATUS" == "skipped" ]] && \
             [[ "$BUILD_STATUS" == "success" || "$BUILD_STATUS" == "skipped" ]] && \
             [[ "$TEST_STATUS" == "success" || "$TEST_STATUS" == "skipped" ]]; then
            echo "overall_status=success" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "overall_status=failure" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Update PR Status Comment
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const status = '${{ steps.status-check.outputs.overall_status }}';
            const hasTsChanges = '${{ needs.detect-changes.outputs.has_ts_changes }}' === 'true';
            const hasDocsChanges = '${{ needs.detect-changes.outputs.has_docs_changes }}' === 'true';
            
            let message = '## Contributor Actions Status\n\n';
            
            if (!hasTsChanges && !hasDocsChanges) {
              message += 'No relevant changes detected.\n';
            } else {
              if (hasTsChanges) {
                message += `- **Lint & Type Check**: ${{ needs.lint-and-typecheck.result === 'skipped' ? 'Skipped' : (needs.lint-and-typecheck.result === 'success' ? '✅ Passed' : '❌ Failed') }}\n`;
                message += `- **Build**: ${{ needs.build.result === 'skipped' ? 'Skipped' : (needs.build.result === 'success' ? '✅ Passed' : '❌ Failed') }}\n`;
                message += `- **Tests**: ${{ needs.test.result === 'skipped' ? 'Skipped' : (needs.test.result === 'success' ? '✅ Passed' : '❌ Failed') }}\n`;
              }
              if (hasDocsChanges) {
                message += `- **Docs**: Changes detected (no automated checks)\n`;
              }
            }
            
            message += `\n**Overall Status**: ${status === 'success' ? '✅ Success' : '❌ Failure'}`;
            
            const { data: comments } = await github.rest.issues.listComments({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
            });
            
            const botComment = comments.find(comment => 
              comment.user.type === 'Bot' && 
              comment.body.includes('## Contributor Actions Status')
            );
            
            if (botComment) {
              await github.rest.issues.updateComment({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                comment_id: botComment.id,
                body: message
              });
            } else {
              await github.rest.issues.createComment({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                issue_number: context.issue.number,
                body: message
              });
            }
```
